Appears to be more a consequence of the repo itself growing rather than a buildsystem-specific change. GCC in particular has been more finicky with the increased size, so this will be getting a dedicated pass in 4.6; something of this scale is out-of-scope for 4.5

Try adding these flags to scons:
```
CCFLAGS="-mcmodel=medium" LINKFLAGS="-mcmodel=medium"
```
It could be because the binary has exceed 2GB size limit allowed by "small" memory code model on 64 bit linux. Using ubsan and asan together with debug symbols can exceed 32 bit.

Why disabling parts might be fixing it:
* Removing 3d removes third party libraries (which are throwing errors). This reduces the size back below 2GB.


Other things you could do:
* build ubsan and asan on separate builds (although not ideal for testing)
* use 32 bit real_t
